title: List of tallest buildings
displaytitle: List of tallest buildings

titles.display: List of tallest buildings

extract: This is a list of the tallest buildings. Tall buildings, such as skyscrapers, are intended here as enclosed structures with continuously occupiable floors and a height of at least 350 metres (1,148 ft). Such definition excludes non-building structures, such as radio towers.
extract_html: This is a list of the tallest buildings. Tall buildings, such as skyscrapers, are intended here as enclosed structures with continuously occupiable floors and a height of at least 350 metres (1,148 ft). Such definition excludes non-building structures, such as radio towers.
